theorems.name: Submission.cbr_imRep_measure_basic
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (W : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep W k), R.measure ≪ μHE[k].restrict R.carrier ∧ μHE[k].restrict R.carrier ≪ R.measure ∧ (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure A = ∫⁻ x in R.carrier ∩ A, (R.mult x : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μHE[k]) ∧ R.measure R.carrierᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ W → R.measure K < ∞) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable R.orient R.measure ∧ ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k, R.action ω = ∫ x, R.orient x (ω x) ∂R.measure
